topics.label: Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by recapping histopathology observations and outlining the core learning objectives.

topics.label: Tumor Virology, Cellular Proto-Oncogenes, and Transformation Assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the historical study of tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and led to laboratory assays for measuring cell transformation.

topics.label: Functional Classification and Mechanisms of Cancer Mutations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the major categories of cancer-associated mutations and illustrate how oncogenic and tumor-suppressive alterations disrupt cellular regulation.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Genetic Instability and Multistep Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the DNA repair and mitotic failure mechanisms causing sequence and chromosomal instability and show how they drive stepwise tumor progression.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predispositions and Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine inherited cancer syndromes and explain how germline mutations and secondary genetic reversions affect disease progression.
